answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Kaboom! first for 1 Energy, then Jumpy Dumpty for 2 Energy. This used all 3 Energy, dealt 7 plus 8 twice to the single enemy, applied Pyro from both attacks, and left the 3 Spark bank untouched.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Jumpy Dumpty followed by Duck and Cover. That line would have used all 3 Energy, dealt the same 16 direct damage from Jumpy Dumpty, and gained 5 Block to fully absorb the telegraphed 4 damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 5 Block and therefore took the full 4 damage, ending the turn at 38 HP instead of 42 HP. It also gave up the defensive option of preserving more health for future turns in exchange for 7 additional damage from Kaboom!.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If the enemy had telegraphed a much larger attack, the extra 5 Block from Jumpy Dumpty plus Duck and Cover would have become much more valuable, and I would likely have chosen the defensive line instead.
